lcc_original: 都兩隻兩隻地來到挪亞那裏，進樓船；有公有母，照上帝【1】所吩咐挪亞的。
notes: 兩隻兩隻 (distributive reduplication) maps to שְׁנַיִם שְׁנַיִם (WH08147×2); each 兩隻 gets one tag to preserve the one-to-one distributive pairing.

Hebrew has one verb בָּאוּ (WH0935/8804) but LCC expands to two motion words 來…進. Following UNV's tagging logic where the verb attaches to the entry/motion word (UNV: 進<WH0935>), I attach WH0935+WTH8804 to 來 (the primary motion initiator) and the second WAH0413 (אֶל before תֵּבָה) to 進, mirroring UNV's 入<WAH0413> pattern.
照 covers both WAH09003 (כַּ prefix) and WH0834 (אֲשֶׁר), since LCC condenses כַּאֲשֶׁר into single character 照.
上帝【1】 is LCC's term for אֱלֹהִים (WH0430); the footnote marker 【1】 is preserved in place, SN appended after.
{<WAH0853>} retained as implicit: LCC omits the Hebrew direct object marker אֵת, so no explicit word to attach it to.
